paragraphs.text: Hello! My name is Liana Kalaitzoglou. I'm an architect from Greece!

I hold two Master's titles, one in Architectural Engineering [MArch] from the Department of Architectural Engineering of the Democritus Politecnic University of Thrace in Greece and another in Ephemeral Architecture and Temporary Spaces [MEATS] from the University Elisava School of Design and Engineering Barcelona.

My interests are focusing on the Design of Temporary Spaces, Public Space Design, Flexible/ Transformable Architecture, Domestic Architecture, and Interior Design! I also worked on projects of retail design and art!

Inspired by innovation, I thrive on experimenting with different concepts and have been commended for inspiring and developing unique and thought-provoking ideas. I have cultivated architecture and design, conceptualization, and construction skills. These strengths, combined with my passion for the artistic approach have created a strong foundation to meet the needs of the Architectural Designer opportunity. I strive to contribute to energetic and team-driven work culture.
